name: Sandbael Meat
effect: A pale, fibrous meat with a similar flavor to crustaceans. Surprisingly few parts of this animal are edible.

name: Sandworm Meat
effect: A firm, chewy meat with a deep flavor. Desert dwellers see it as a valuable source of protein.
how_to_get: Bought From Kira Market; Sandworm Meat can be bought at Kira, located south of the continent. If you've reached Chapter 6 in Cai's Path and unlocked the Gate of the Gods in his route, you can fast travel from Dagsion to Aurora's Temple to save turns.; Get Sandworm Meat from Exploring Aditi's Cave; You can get Sandworm Meat by defeating the Sandworm enemies in Aditi's Cave dungeon, which is found in the desert areas.; Get Sandworm Meat from Luxury Meat Crates or Worms; You can also get Sandworm Meat from Luxury Meat Crates. You can head to Secret Altar and use Search to gather the crates. However, Sandworm Meat will appear at random from this crates, so gather several crates in case you don't get the required amount of meat after opening the crates.; Alternatively, you can find Worms that spawn in the World Map. Engage them in combat and there's a chance for them to drop Sandworm Meat upon defeat.

name: Louse Meat

name: Sanbael Meat

name: Sea-Beast Meat

name: Rukh Meat

name: Flying-Lizard Meat

name: Giants' Meat

how_to_get: Take Out Giants in Skirmishes Around Pasithea; You can eliminate Giants in Skirmish Battles around Pasithea to get Giants' Meat. Do note that you will have to find these skirmishes for them trigger, unless you're in Dietrich's Route, where he can use Answerer's Call to force Skirmish spawns around the map.; How to Navigate the World Map; Get from Luxury Meat Crates; You can get Giants' Meat from Luxury Meat Crates. You can head to Secret Altar and use Search to gather the crates.; However, Giants' Meat will appear at random, so gather several crates in case you don't get the required amount of meat after opening the crates.

name: Spellcaster's Relics

how_to_get: Defeat the Enemies at Secret Altar in Saveilon; Triggering the subquest Purloined Spellcaster's Tools will allow you to battle Har Hali enemies in Saveilon's Secret Altar. Defeating the enemies here will reward you with the Spellcaster's Relics that you must deliver to the Tool Merchant in the Arena Plaza in Dagsion.; This quest is time-limited, so make sure to finish it in time to avoid missing the rewards and failing!; How to Navigate the World Map

name: Violet Brooch

how_to_get: Defeat the Bandits at Axion Forge in Saveilon; Triggering the subquest My Late Sister's Accessory will allow you to battle Bandits in Saveilon's Axion Forge. Defeating the enemies here will reward you with the Violet Brooch that you must deliver to Creek in Dagsion.; This quest is time-limited, so make sure to finish it in time to avoid missing the rewards and failing!; How to Navigate the World Map

name: Monument Verse
effect: A verse from the monument of a legendary poet. Return it to Sirocco right away.
how_to_get: Found in Atla Peak During Sirocco's Request; Monument Verse is a quest-exclusive item that can only be obtained after accepting Sirocco's recruitment request on Cai, Dietrich, and Theodora Paths.; The copy of the Monument Verse is obtained by using the Search function on Atla Peak in the Solidus Province.; How to Recruit Sirocco; Iapetus Cavern is the only accessible point which will get you to Atla Peak. You cannot get to Atla Peak from Da Mina until after you reach it from the other side.; The Iapetus Cavern is filled with a lot of high level enemies, so if your party is too low leveled, we recommend avoiding clashes and running directly to the dungeon's exit.; If you are under Renown Level 6, you will not be able to enter the Solidus region through the border points. However, you can still access Solidus by going West from the Gorbea Stronghold Ruins.; However, keep in mind that this is a longer route, and may take more turns to reach Atla Peak. Make sure to plot ahead of time if you plan on taking this route.

how_to_get: Find Archive Z in Southern Passage Dungeon; The Archive Z scroll can be found in a treasure chest in Southern Passage, a futuristic-looking dungeon in the deserts of Nysiades.; All Flame Lords can also go here during Part I of their routes except for Cai, who cannot access Nysiades Desert until Part 3.; 100% Walkthrough Guide

name: Archive Gamma (Γ)

how_to_get: Find Archive Γ in Aditi's Cave; The Archive Γ scroll found in a treasure chest in Aditi's Cave, a dungeon in the deserts of Nysiades north of Baina Oasis.; All Flame Lords can also go here during Part I of their routes except for Cai, who cannot access Nysiades Desert until Part 3.; 100% Walkthrough Guide; Exchange in Dagsion Port; Around Part 1, you can go to Dagsion Port and exchange with the Vandahl Trading Company there with 10 Pongo and 1 Glirmosa to get Archive Γ.

name: Archive Beta (B)

All Flame Lords can also go here during Part I of their routes.; 100% Walkthrough Guide; Exchange in Dagsion Port; Around Part 1, you can go to Dagsion Port and exchange with the Vandahl Trading Company there with 3 Torment Grass to get Archive B.

name: Archive Theta (θ)

The item itself is in a Treasure Chest that you can find by exploring the area.; All Flame Lords can also go here during Part I of their routes except for Cai, as his route makes exploring the northern desert range of the map difficult until Part 3.; 100% Walkthrough Guide

name: Archive Tau (T)

how_to_get: The Archive θ scroll can be found in Iapetus Cavern, a dungeon located in Solidus, northern Dagsion. name: Scarlet Firedrops
effect: Part of Olympia's Recruitment Quests, completing will proceed with the next recruitment quest.
how_to_get: Find and Search in Daybreak Plains; Go to Daybreak Plains by traveling from East Amalthea Station to Feronia Station, which takes about 5 turns from Dagsion. If you haven't unlocked the stations yet, you'll need more turns to reach your destination. From there, you can Search the area and hopefully find the Scarlet Firedrops required.; How to Navigate the World Map

name: Aurum Rose
effect: Part of Olympia's Recruitment Quests, completing will proceed with the next recruitment quest.
how_to_get: Search in Klytius Plains or Baina Oasis; Head to Baina Oasis or Klytius Plains to find Aurum Rose. Baina Oasis can be found in Nysiades desert and is accessible to all Flame Lords except Cai until Part 3. Cai can instead find the item in Klytius Plains, which, for the fastest route, requires using at least the Callisto Porthouse in Saveilon.; How to Navigate the World Map

name: Azure Heart

how_to_get: Found in Valhalla Mine Dungeon; Azure Heart can be found in the Valhalla Mine dungeon in Saveilon, as a visible pick-up on the ground. You can go through this area quicker via Salacia Porthouse through Tritopater Corridor.; How to Navigate the World Map
